audit.whatIsWrong: Devour is labelled W in three places, and the shield is called a 'grey-health passive' in five.
audit.why: Devour is his R. W is Abyssal Dive, a 21/20/19/18/17s dive that knocks up on arrival at 1000-1200 range. The grey health is Thick Skin (E): it stores a percentage of damage taken, heals from it out of combat, and converts the whole store into a shield on a 3-second cooldown for zero mana — which is why bursting him under the execute floor in one pass rarely works. His passive, An Acquired Taste, is bonus damage from total health plus the three stacks that unlock Devour, and Tongue Lash heals him whenever it strikes a champion and stuns at three stacks.
audit.corrected: Devour reassigned to R; the shield attributed to Thick Skin with its 3-second cooldown; Abyssal Dive's knockup and cooldown stated; Tongue Lash's heal-on-champion added.

audit.why: Abyssal Dive at 21/20/19/18/17s is the right tracked cooldown; the number is now on the page.

notes: Devour was labelled W in three fields — it is his R, and W is Abyssal Dive. The 'grey-health passive' the page leans on five times is actually Thick Skin (E): free, 3-second cooldown, converts stored damage into a shield, which is the concrete reason a single burst pass does not hold him under the Purgatory floor. His actual passive is An Acquired Taste, whose three stacks are what unlock Devour in the first place.
